_meta.purpose: Data-layer registry for the Zodiac Roles Modifier scoping milestone (rebalancer-bot). Single source of truth for addresses and parameters used in generated calldata — no value here should be hand-duplicated elsewhere without pointing back to this file.
_meta.rule: Any field with verified=false or a value of '#NEEDS-CLARIFICATION' BLOCKS use of that field in generated calldata. generate-verification should enforce this mechanically, not rely on the agent remembering to check.

executionModel.setup: Every transaction produced from this registry is signed manually by Baris via the Safe UI, one at a time, after reading the generated human-readable diff. No skill in this milestone submits or broadcasts a transaction.
executionModel.runtime: Later, the bot EOA (role.member) calls execTransactionWithRole from n8n, unattended. That is explicitly out of scope for this milestone and depends entirely on this milestone's scoping being correct and verified first.
